question: What predicted target-grid support and collisions result from one fixed four-history geometry state across all four requested optical cameras?
expected_computation: All16source-target pairs retained, mutually exclusive source statuses and all eligible positive footprints, deterministic hard depth winner/second item, holes explicitly retained. These are implementation checks, not geometry quality success criteria.
input_identity_basis: Inherited from accepted S83/S69 textual receipts; actual file bytes and decoded selected field body hashes are checked at real execution. Preparation did not reopen numeric NPZ values.
input_open_scope: Read/hash each whole original NPZ byte string once, decode only specified fields from the same BytesIO. S83 contains bundled unused confidence/world points/etc but none decoded. S69 c2ws decodes9cameras; only targetIDs20/21/22/23 participate. No source RGB files or checkpoint or target RGB/sensor file reads.
source_geometry: Saved FP32 depth/K/c2w values; numerical projection promotes toFP64. No nominal-K replacement, scale fit, optical axis flip, recentering, timestamp substitution, undistortion or pose optimization. Source RGB keptFP32 for exact winner copy.

coordinates.arithmetic: Pinhole ray followed by explicit scalar-coefficient3x3 transforms inFP64; no BLAS/einsum
coordinates.pose_validation_meaning: Structural numerical guard, not pose accuracy

source_status_priority.name: TARGET_NONFINITE
source_status_priority.detail: XYZ nonfinite first; positive-Z division that yields nonfiniteUV also enters this class

source_status_priority.name: OUTSIDE
source_status_priority.detail: Finite positive-Z center outside closed[0,575]^2; no clip or boundary rescue

coordinates.footprint: Strictly positive weights on00,10,01,11 floor neighbors with in-bounds integer coordinates, only for continuous centers inside closed domain. No approximate zero, epsilon, snap or filling.
coordinates.hard_order: Target pixel primary, targetZ ascending, priority19/18/13/12, original pixelID ascending; slot final key only for deterministic completeness and cannot duplicate a pixel in valid2x2 footprints.
coordinates.second_candidate: Second item of full order, including equal-Z ties; never second distinct depth layer
coordinates.color: One winner RGB copied exactly; weights only determine footprint qualification, no average/weighted color
coordinates.holes: maskFalse/RGB0/IDs-1/ZNaN; missing support not GT invisible or known black

runtime.thread_control: Six NumPy/OpenMP/BLAS environment variables set to1 before NumPy import; projection uses explicit elementwise multiplies/sums and lexsort, no BLAS call.

resources.control: Internal SIGALRM, per-stage peak-self RSS checks, conservative uncompressed-output prewrite estimates+16MiB reserve. Not a kernel hard address-space limit; root records external process exit/time.
resources.memory_preflight: Sequential targets, at most3,145,728footprints per target; fixed arrays and sorting copies estimated below1.5GiB before execution, not measured. Actual peak sampled from ru_maxrss.
resources.output_format: Uncompressed NPZ only for scientific arrays; no PNG rendering, CSV duplication or giant logs in this run.

outputs.INPUT_GEOMETRY.npz: Actual consumed source depth/colors/savedFP32 K/P/historyIDs plus selected targetFP64P/K/IDs; input copy for saved-output recomputation, no unconsumed arrays.

TARGET_{20,21,22,23}.npz.C: Target-dependent total positive footprint candidates, 0<=C<=3,145,728; sorted in hard-order, losses retained

source_pixel_id.meaning: C-order pixel ID shared by all histories

source_status.meaning: Exactly one status per source point

target_xyz.meaning: Target camera XYZ; NaN if source invalid; nonfinite transform retained

target_uv.meaning: Continuous target coordinates; undefined NaN for unprojected/behind; outside finite coordinates retained

footprint_weight.meaning: Strictly positive eligible bilinear weight; zero at ineligible slots; no epsilon/snap

footprint_winner.meaning: Candidate won its target pixel; false for loser/ineligible, distinguished by index

candidate_weight.meaning: Positive qualification weight, not color mixing weight

candidate_rank.meaning: Zero-based complete rank at this target pixel

mask.meaning: At least one eligible candidate; not GT visibility

candidate_count.meaning: All eligible footprint candidates, not distinct depth layers

warp_rgb.meaning: Exact source RGB of winner; holes zero-filled, not observed black

second_candidate_source_row.meaning: Second means complete-sort item2, may equal winner Z; absent identity=-1/Z=NaN

second_candidate_pixel_id.meaning: Second means complete-sort item2, may equal winner Z; absent identity=-1/Z=NaN

second_candidate_slot.meaning: Second means complete-sort item2, may equal winner Z; absent identity=-1/Z=NaN

second_candidate_Z.meaning: Second means complete-sort item2, may equal winner Z; absent identity=-1/Z=NaN

second_candidate_history_id.meaning: Second means complete-sort item2, may equal winner Z; absent identity=-1/Z=NaN

outputs.SUMMARY.json: Incremental PARTIAL after each target; final16pair source/status/footprint/win/loss counts and4target coverage/holes/collisions with fixed denominators. No sensor/image accuracy scoring.
outputs.RECEIPT.json: Actual input read/decode list, byte/body validation, source/contract/runtime identity, target progress, all NPZ SHA/schema, summary SHA, runtime/RSS/output bytes, true failure and completion state.
outputs.TRACEBACK.txt: Only on failure; partial files retained. Any input/schema/color structural failure may stop before scientific rows; no invented complete output.

implementation_test.scope: Three hand fixtures plus endpoint/outside/rotation/nonfinite/color/all-hole artificial cases only; once, no real arrays or batches.

scientific_limits: Predicted support is not physical visibility, occlusion truth, calibrated confidence or accuracy.
Single exposed scene and historical selection limitations persist.
A fixed100step state is used by design, not selected because of1.2mm reference change.
No new video, guidance consumer, scale fitting or method claim; G0/Gpaste/Gguide frozen separately later.
